name: Homelab
creator: NanoKVM Community
desc: Status board that checks every service in a Dashy config, with mDNS support for .local hosts.

DASHY_URL.label: Dashy URL
DASHY_URL.description: Dashy address such as http://raspberrypi.local:4000, or a direct link to its conf.yml. Leave empty to use a conf.yml bundled in the App directory.

CHECK_INTERVAL.label: Check interval (seconds)
CHECK_INTERVAL.description: How often every service is checked. Minimum 5.

CHECK_TIMEOUT.label: Check timeout (seconds)
CHECK_TIMEOUT.description: How long to wait for a service before marking it down.
